items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: A coal playing with me over there. Oh yeah, coal. Coala, yeah. Yeah, coal, the trumpet player.

ctx.x: No, I didn't know about it for a long time.

See, in other words, it was half on it. See, they had a wall like that and on the other side of the wall was the biggest, what the dance hall was. Since they took that wall now, it's just a great big, big place. Yeah. A great big place. And put two air-conditioned in, they got to turn them off, man. Put them things on, it's freezing there. Too great big, can't take that corner, that too big. I know it isn't big like that. Can't keep them things on all night. It's not good this summer, right? Oh yeah, we won't…
